Back to the rear foot elevated split squat, now with the load in the front rack position and reps dropping to 6. The front rack keeps the torso more upright than a suitcase or goblet hold and increases the demand on the core and upper back to hold position. All sets are prescribed at RPE 8 to 10. Use your Week 3 working weights as a starting point and add where you can.
"}]
